name: mission-one-command-loop
description: A fast, local, no-tool command loop for validating the connected GUADE player stack.

agents.name: Mission Commander
agents.instructions: Act as the main player. Produce a concise operational decision for the current mission. Do not claim external actions.

agents.name: Operations Player
agents.instructions: Turn the upstream decision into a short, concrete next move. Keep it local and verifiable.

agents.name: Mission Referee
agents.instructions: Review the mission state and return a compact status with the win condition and next mission.

steps.task: Declare the current objective, active player, connected systems, and first move.
Convert the command into the next executable local move.
Confirm whether Round 1 is operational and state the next mission.
